question: International Day of Non-violence is observed on ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thu Oct 02 2025 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The International Day of Non-Violence is observed on **October 2nd** each year.
 
• This date was chosen to honor the birthday of **Mahatma Gandhi**, the leader of the Indian independence movement and a pioneer of the philosophy and strategy of non-violence.
 
• The day was established by the United Nations General Assembly in **2007**.
 
• The resolution for the International Day of Non-Violence was co-sponsored by **140 countries**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahatma Gandhi**:

 
 
• Born on October 2, 1869, in Porbandar, India.
 
• Known for his principles of **Satyagraha** (truth and non-violence).
 
• Played a crucial role in India's struggle for independence from British rule.
 
• Assassinated on January 30, 1948, in New Delhi, India.
 
 
 
• **Non-Violence**:
 
 
• A philosophy and strategy for social change that rejects the use of violence.
 
• Prominent non-violent leaders include Martin Luther King Jr., Nelson Mandela, and Cesar Chavez.
 
• Non-violence is also a principle in various religious traditions, including Hinduism, Buddhism, and Christianity.
 
 
 
• **United Nations General Assembly**:
 
 
• One of the six principal organs of the United Nations.
 
• Comprises all 193 member states of the UN.
 
• Responsible for making important decisions on peace and security, admission of new members, and budgetary matters.
 
• Resolutions adopted by the General Assembly are non-binding but carry significant moral weight.
 
 
 
• **Global Observances**:
 
 
• International days are occasions to educate the public on issues of concern.
 
• They mobilize political will and resources to address global problems.
 
• Examples include International Women's Day (March 8), World Health Day (April 7), and International Day of Peace (September 21).
